call_points.text: Vision 2031 targets #1 in 2W and 4W tyre aftermarket in India and 15% share in commercial radials.
CAMSO full portfolio unlocks after brand migration in Sep 2028, with $1.0 Bn revenue potential.
EBITDA gap to peers narrowed to 1.9% in FY26 from 3.4% in FY22 on standalone basis.
FY26 debt/EBITDA was 1.46x and debt/equity 0.60x, with an AA rating (outlook +ve).
CEAT is a supplier to all major EV OEMs in India, with EV business share of 31% and 19% in two segments.
CEAT ranked #2 in premium PCUV in Q4FY26, up from #5 in Q1FY25.

operating_notes.text: Tyresnmore Online Private Limited, incorporated 2 June 2014 and based in New Delhi, sells automotive tyres and accessories and offers fitting, wheel balancing and alignment services; turnover was ₹1,481.15 lakh in FY23, ₹2,558.64 lakh in FY
CGST & Central Excise Mumbai Central quashed 4 SCNs for ₹276.7 Cr excise duty demand on tyre set assembly for March 2011 to June 2017.
FY26 debt/EBITDA 1.46x and debt/equity 0.60x; credit rating AA with positive outlook.
EBITDA gap to peers narrowed to 1.9% in FY26 from 3.4% in FY22 on standalone basis.
CEAT is a supplier to all major EV OEMs in India, with EV business share of 31% and 19% in two segments.
Rectified GST order (DRC-08) for FY2019-20 Tamil Nadu reduced confirmed demand to ₹3.2 Cr tax and ₹3.2 Cr penalty plus interest, from ₹4.7 Cr each; company exploring an appeal.
Debt increased during the quarter due to higher capital expenditure of close to ₹490 crore and dividend payouts.

timeline.summary: On 20 April 2026 CEAT approved a ₹3.25 Cr cash subscription to 26,626 equity shares of its wholly owned subsidiary Tyresnmore Online Private Limited via a rights issue, keeping its stake at 100%, with allotment due by 8 May 2026.
CEAT incorporated a German step-down subsidiary, CEAT GMBH, with a capital of Euro 25,000.
Commissioner CGST & Central Excise quashed 4 SCNs demanding ₹276.7 Cr differential excise duty on tyre set assembly without penalty.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹4,218.89 Cr, net profit ₹243.8 Cr.
On 28 April 2026, CEAT reported Q4 FY26 consolidated revenue of ₹4,218.9 Cr and net profit of ₹243.8 Cr.
On 29 April 2026, CEAT provided the audio recording link for its Q4 FY26 earnings call.

On 25 May 2026, CEAT filed an investor presentation for the RPG Annual Investor Conference setting a Vision 2031 target of #1 in 2W/4W tyres and 15% commercial radial share, with CAMSO brand migration by Sep 2028.

On 4 June 2026, CEAT disclosed a rectified GST order (DRC-08, 3 June 2026) cutting a Tamil Nadu FY2019-20 demand to ₹3.2 Cr tax and ₹3.2 Cr penalty from ₹4.7 Cr each, with no material impact expected.
Q2FY27 results (consolidated): revenue ₹4,762 Cr (+26.2% YoY), net profit to shareholders ₹26 Cr (-86.0% YoY).
